Requirement Description: The login page shall display username and password fields and a Login button
Valid documented credentials shall grant access to the dashboard
An incorrect password shall be rejected with an error message
An unknown username shall be rejected with an error message
Empty username and password shall be rejected
Username shorter than 3 characters shall be rejected
Password shorter than 6 characters shall be rejected
The password field shall mask typed characters
A logged-in user shall be able to log out and return to the login form
The page shall be responsive on small screens
